description: Client.open handles POST cancel by calling require_operator and returning 403 before the WSGI application runs, so the cancel route's operator check is never what the member test exercises.
author: grok-4.7-medium-fast
why_hard: Member and operator cancellation tests both call Client.open, and the 403 is produced by a require_operator call placed after the WSGI environ is built, so the helper still looks like it sends the cancel request.
